title: Replace matching text
summary: Perl: Replace matching text. Remove g and compare.
introduction: s/old/new/ replaces matching text. The g flag replaces all matches.

blocks.text: Install Perl 5. Save one example as lesson.pl and run perl lesson.pl.

blocks.title: Replace matching text

blocks.text: The g flag makes replacement repeat for every match. Both red words become blue.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Without g, only the first match is replaced.
